attr.title: 20 Minutes Till Dawn
attr.desc: A survival roguelite where endless hordes of creatures lurk in the dark. Craft overpowering builds and wipe out waves of Lovecraftian nightmares. Will you survive the night?
attr.inst: Purchase the game on Steam and use the Steam console to download the macOS build: `download_depot 1966900 1966902`. Copy `20MinutesTillDawn.app` from the download into `ports/20minutestilldawn/gamedata/`. The first start downloads Unity's Linux player (57 MB, needs internet) and adapts the game files, which takes a few minutes.
